You receive a plain-English report with screenshots, the problems ranked by effort and impact, and the exact steps to fix each one. Higher packages include a walkthrough call and fixes made for you.

faq: What do I get at the end?
A written report with screenshots, every problem ranked by effort and likely payoff, and clear steps to fix each one. Anyone on your team or your developer can follow it without help from us.
Do you change anything on my store?
Not in the first two packages. The audit is read only. The top package includes up to 5 quick fixes, which we make in a copy of your theme and show you before publishing.
A staff or collaborator invite with read access to your Shopify admin and analytics. We never ask for your password, and you can remove us once the report is delivered.
Can you fix everything you find?
Yes, if you want. After the report we can quote the fixes as separate work. You are free to take the report to your own developer instead.
